lines.trans: Hello! Come over here! I have a job for you!
See that hanging there? — Yes, it's been hanging there for a month.
It needs to come down! You climb onto the window and knock it down with the mop.
And I'll spot you. Got it? — Yes, got it!
Grab the mop, go! Come on, come on!
Oh stop it, Klavdia Viktorovna! Fine, I'll climb up myself.
Just hold me! — How do I hold you? — Gently!
Look, hold me by the leg. Like that! Hold tighter!
Oh! Our condensed milk just exploded!
I'll go find her right now! — What are you doing, Arkasha?
